race.description: Dual World Champion Jody Jamieson Is Udc Bound Pace
race.comment: POCKET BOOK NZ (6) made it three minor placings from her past four starts when she finished 3 metres away in second last time out at this circuit and distance. Draws wider but with even luck she is capable of getting the job done. The recent form of VICTREE CHARLIE (1) may not appeal on paper but he has had a series of wide or second row barriers so can do better from the ace draw. THE REAL ROCKETMAN NZ (10) draws on the back row but is on the radar after his last-start fourth over this distance five days ago and a win here last month. BEAU STEELE (2) draws better than in recent attempts and came from this same position when fourth here earlier in the month. Player.
